method.resources: 2 Slurm CPUs, 2G per CPU, pinned to one logical CPU/physical core; 1 worker, threads 1
method.stages: DelPhi cputime log intervals: surface = time-to-turn-everything-in minus read/assign; solver = elapsed after iterations minus setup; energy = energy-done minus elapsed after iterations. They exclude other work; CPU intervals are not wall times. Per-call wall includes reading and serializing logs; perturbs benchmark. Process-tree RSS sampled every 50 ms, summed, shared memory double counted. Baseline uninstrumented prior benchmark for wall comparison.
method.final_change: maximum potential change at stop, not equation residual
method.grid: 81^3 float32, coarse 1 and focused/model 4 grids per Angstrom; max change 0.01 kT/e checked every 10, limit 500
method.tools: ltrace present login, absent compute node. No perf counters or native source available; no bytes-per-sweep, arithmetic intensity or confirmed hardware bottleneck.
